about_the_game:
WELCOME TO RUMBLE!

Instead of with button inputs, this multiplayer VR fighting game is played by performing martial arts-inspired movements. RUMBLE has a heavy focus on practise and repetition, on getting good. You won’t be a master on day one, but keep fighting, keep learning, and one day you will be.

RUMBLE'S ACTION

In RUMBLE, you will find many moves to master! Each move you learn has its own unique effect, and you can combine the effects of different moves by performing them in a combo to create your own unique attacks!

You can perform a move by striking the martial arts inspired pose that is tied to the move you want to use. By chaining poses together, you can perform multiple moves back to back, combining their effects to form a move combo! The faster you become, the more complex your combos can be, allowing for more unique and creative ways to attack your opponent and defend yourself.

Our community has already taken RUMBLE’s combat mechanics further than we imagined, expanded the boundaries of what was thought possible several times over. How far will you push the envelope? What new tech will you discover?

ONLINE PLAY

  • INTENSE ARENA COMBAT

Engage in 1-on-1 duels with other players in the Arena! Playing in the Arena will reward you with Battle Points; collecting these will unlock new moves for you to use in combat. In addition to Battle Points, you’ll also be granted Gear Coins, which you can trade in to unlock new gear for your character to wear!

  • MULTIPLAYER PHYSICS SANDBOX

Park Sessions allow for up to 6 fighters to play together! There’s plenty of space to experiment with physics and performing moves, there are mini-games to play, and even some toys scattered all around the place with which you can set up your own minigames.

  • DISCORD COMMUNITY

Our RUMBLE Discord Community server has grown quite a bit since launch! With over 10K members, it’s an excellent place for finding people to play with, asking questions about the game, or even communicating directly with us, the developers!

You can join our Discord community by clicking on the Discord button on the right.

MORE FEATURES

  • CHARACTER CUSTOMIZATION

By fighting in the Arena, you earn Gear Coins, which you can use to unlock new customization options for your character. You can edit many parts of your character individually to truly make yourself stand out. From your smile to your boots to the sparkle in your eyes, it’s all up to you!

  • OFFLINE TRAINING EQUIPMENT

While RUMBLE is primarily an online experience, there are some tools with which you can interact when you’re not feeling particularly sociable. There’s a sparring bot named Howard you can use to practice your combat skills in an offline setting, there’s the Pose Ghost that can show and teach you how to perform any of RUMBLE’s moves, and you can host private Park sessions to play with any of the toys you can find there.

  • THE ROCK CAM

An in-game camera tool with which you can effortlessly take screenshots and record gameplay footage!

Built with the LIV Creator Kit, it’s an excellent tool for anyone looking to create any kind of RUMBLE content. The cameras are networked too; other players can see and hear you using your Rock Cam, and if they’re feeling particularly mischievous, they might even try to take it from you!

  • CROSS-PLATFORM PLAY & FRIEND SYSTEM

RUMBLE can be played across several platforms, but regardless of where you own it, you will be able to play with friends and strangers playing on other platforms.

Either set up an Arena fight with a single friend, or hang out in the Park with up to 5 others!

Right now, the game is only available on Steam and on the PCVR Meta store, but when the game launches on standalone VR devices later this year, this feature will ensure nobody has to miss out on any parts of RUMBLE’s amazing community.
detailed_description:
Note to WMR users

Although RUMBLE is fully playable with a Windows Mixed Reality (WMR) headset, not all of those headsets provide an optimal gameplay experience. We have made a forum post with more information as to which WMR headsets we recommend for playing RUMBLE.

Please visit the Discussions page for more information about the WMR headsets.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: Intel i3-6100/AMD Ryzen 3 1200, FX4350 or greater
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti/AMD Radeon RX 470 or greater
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • VR Support: SteamVR. Standing or Room Scale
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: Become the greatest RUMBLE fighter the world has ever seen! By performing specific martial-arts inspired movements, you can control the earth around you. Gain mastery over this power, and use it to defeat your opponents in intense 1-on-1 PVP duels!
